name: U Blei Nongthaw
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. U Blei Nongthaw negotiates constitutional standing for hill assemblies in their dealings with the valley crown. Common access to springs and roads tests whether the new state will recognize assembly jurisdiction. The University register proposes a connection to Pragjyotisha Hill Autonomy Charter. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
